[Db]and disregard.

[B]chest. Lights! Out!

[Db]blown.

[Db]unworthy,

[Db]Not! One!
Single bone in your
[B]back. Own! Up!

[Db]wn.

for you and me,

veryone's the same.

we know, we know.
[Gb]

rather know the pain.

happens almost ne-

ends we seam toge-
